option_relations.rationale: Eosinophilic annular erythema (EAE) is a distinct dermatological condition, not directly related to ipilimumab-induced rash as a specific subtype or cause.
Wells syndrome (eosinophilic cellulitis) is a specific inflammatory skin condition, not directly related to ipilimumab-induced rash as a subtype or cause.
Granuloma annulare is a benign inflammatory skin condition, not directly related to ipilimumab-induced rash as a subtype or cause.
Drug-induced erythema annulare centrifugum is a pattern of drug reaction, but the specific drug (ipilimumab) is not mentioned in the option, and the leaf is more specific to ipilimumab-induced rash.
